## Problem 1(d)

Estimator from part (a):

```{r}
set.seed(71)
alpha_stat <- rep(0, 1000)
for (i in 1:1000) {
x <- rexp(50, rate = 1/3)
alpha <- (mean(x)^2)
alpha_stat[i] <- alpha
}

mean(alpha_stat)
var(alpha_stat)
```

MSE:

```{r}
(mean(alpha_stat)-9)^2+var(alpha_stat)
```

Estimator from part (b):

```{r}
beta_stat <- rep(0, 1000)
for (i in 1:1000) {
x <- rexp(50, rate = 1/3)
beta <- ((1/100)*sum(x^2))
beta_stat[i] <- beta
}

mean(beta_stat)
var(beta_stat)
```

MSE:

```{r}
(mean(beta_stat)-9)^2+var(beta_stat)
```
